column1: # v1 had ONE ROW PER TRIGGER, which is exactly the data-model fault PLAN §3
# records for the original: "the vocabulary asserted one part of speech and one
# sense per word -- errors 1 and 2 were the data model working as written, not
# bugs." Entries are now keyed by (trigger, sense).
# block_context : if any of these content words appear in the sentence, veto.
#                 Each one was derived from an observed failure, not guessed.
# require_context: if non-empty, at least one must appear.

column8: note
dull blade is the sharpness sense
cautious optimism is fixed
morose is of people, not weather
peaceful protest is political, not calm
perilous describes situations, not agents
a person cannot be "opaque as to whether"
DEFER: hard_word is polysemous
be careful not to is a warning, not praise
amicable is for disputes; blocks X-friendly compounds
blocks the taste sense
slow in music is a tempo term
blocks "tough neighborhoods/times"
lazy afternoon is leisurely, not idle
churlish is about ingratitude, not obscenity
obstreperous is of people
blocks named entities and fixed phrases
profuse pairs with apologies/bleeding/sweating
blocks the legal-document AND the duration senses
mundane means dull, not "average"; blocks "ordinary people"
replaces v1's scarce->sparse, which confused quantity with distribution
hate speech/crime are fixed
divulge takes information, not phenomena
corroborate needs evidence, not admin confirmation
eschew is principled abstention, not evasion
forsake is moral; blocks physical abandonment
relinquish needs an entitlement
blocks "surrender to police"
condemned building is the legal sense
attributive "undermined state" does not work
endangered species is fixed
blocks the refuse-noun sense
wane is of power/interest, not pigment
eradicate takes afflictions, not places
disseminate is deliberate distribution
